output.brief: The soft-pedal complaints are concentrated in vans serviced at Northfield Motor Services during the bay closure. Eleven of the 13 Northfield vans account for all 27 complaints. Drivers logged 604 days in other vans with no brake reports, Upper Wend is run by all 38 vans, and Tessaro pads are on many vans that never complained. That points away from driver technique, the route, the pads, and the app change. Brake fluid during the Northfield work is the leading suspect, but I have not confirmed it: I did not read the Northfield job cards. I am fairly confident about the pattern and less sure about the mechanism. Next: take the Northfield-serviced vans out of service and have their brake fluid boiling-point tested and renewed from sealed stock. Get the Northfield job cards to confirm fluid type. Drop the proposed warnings and retraining, since they punish drivers for reporting and do not address the cause. Keep the pads question open until fresh-pad noise data are compared.
